VIPCOO H6 Electric Dirt Bike | 60V 6000W Off-Road Electric Motorcycle | High Torque Adventure Bike
Take on rough trails, dirt tracks and off-road terrain with the VIPCOO H6 Electric Dirt Bike. Built with a powerful 60V system, gearbox reduction motor, long-lasting battery and professional suspension setup, the H6 is designed for riders who want stronger torque, better control and a more exciting off-road experience.
Powerful 60V 6000W Motor
The VIPCOO H6 is equipped with a 60V 6000W motor for strong acceleration and confident hill-climbing performance. With a gearbox reduction system, the motor delivers greater torque to the rear wheel, reaching up to 290 N.m wheel torque for better traction and off-road power.Whether riding on gravel, dirt paths, grassland or uneven trails, the H6 gives riders responsive power and a more thrilling riding feel.
60V 31.5Ah High-Capacity Battery
Powered by a 60V 31.5Ah battery, the H6 offers long-lasting riding performance for outdoor adventures. The large-capacity battery is designed to support extended off-road sessions, giving riders more freedom to explore without frequent charging.
Advanced Off-Road Suspension
- Front hydraulic suspension- Rear nitrogen shock absorberThis suspension combination helps absorb impact from bumps, rough tracks and uneven terrain, delivering a smoother and more controlled riding experience. It is ideal for off-road riders who need comfort, stability and confidence across challenging surfaces.
19/17-Inch All-Terrain Tyres
- Front tyre: 19-inch off-road tyre- Rear tyre: 17-inch off-road tyreThe larger front wheel improves obstacle handling, while the rear tyre provides strong grip and driving stability. This setup helps the VIPCOO H6 perform across dirt, gravel, grass, muddy paths and mountain terrain.
Hydraulic Braking System
The H6 features front and rear hydraulic brakes, offering responsive stopping power and improved riding safety. Strong braking performance helps shorten stopping distance and gives riders better control during off-road use.
Smart Colour Display
The built-in colour display clearly shows key riding information, including:- Speed- Battery level- Gear position- Fault code alertsThis makes it easy for riders to monitor their bike status at a glance, especially during longer rides.
Three Speed Modes
The VIPCOO H6 comes with three speed modes, allowing riders to choose the right level of power for different riding conditions.The top speed can reach up to 80km/h under full-battery, no-load conditions, giving the H6 strong performance for private land and off-road use.
Built for Real Off-Road Riding
